name: ModelVariant676Us_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant676us_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (command 0 flashes a sprite and a fan of shaded triangles on a model point, then scatters a ring of shards and fires a burst of spinning ribbons that settles into a ring of strips, a tumbling lattice and an expanding wave; command 1 starts the ring and the wave at a fixed offset); for a non-negative request it sets the effect up from the command row indexed by the request, otherwise it runs one frame; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the French header-693 images build the same source through french_model_variant/variant693_entry.c with VERSION_FRENCH and bind the data names 0x28 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
